children: Champion Homes announced a definitive agreement to acquire the assets of Timberline Homes, adding nine retail locations in Alabama, Mississippi and Florida.
Agreement to acquire Timberline Homes' assets, representing nine retail locations in the Southeastern U.S.
Deal expands Champion Homes' retail footprint in Alabama, Mississippi and Florida to support direct-to-consumer strategy.
Locations align with Champion's manufacturing and distribution presence, expected to increase market access.
Transaction subject to customary closing conditions; expected to close in Champion Homes' Q4 FY2027.
All Timberline employees will be offered employment by Champion following closing to aid integration.
